questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 on / in / under
questions.question: 「书包在椅子下面。」应说（　）
options: The bag is under the chair.
The bag is on the chair.
The bag is in the chair.
questions.answer: The bag is under the chair.

questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 on / in / under
questions.question: in 表示「在……里面」。

knowledge_summary.point: 教室词汇 classroom / desk / chair / blackboard
knowledge_summary.core_concept: classroom 教室、desk 课桌、chair 椅子、blackboard 黑板。
knowledge_summary.key_formula: in the classroom 在教室里
knowledge_summary.tips: desk 桌面大，chair 是坐的。

knowledge_summary.point: 方位介词 on / in / under
knowledge_summary.core_concept: on 在……上面、in 在……里面、under 在……下面。句型 Where is…? It's on the desk.
knowledge_summary.key_formula: It's on the desk. / It's in the bag.
knowledge_summary.tips: 接触表面用 on，包在里面用 in。
